title: Globe Business connects first inter-regional telesurgery across 1,400 kilometers to expand specialized healthcare access

blocks.text: Across the Philippine archipelago, access to advanced surgical care remains heavily concentrated in major metropolitan centers. For millions of patients outside major urban hubs, particularly in Mindanao, receiving specialized surgical intervention often requires long-distance travel, substantial travel expenses, and extended time away from families. In time-sensitive conditions, geographical distance can directly impact patient outcomes. In a landmark demonstration of how enterprise infrastructure can overcome these regional healthcare disparities, Globe Business provided the dedicated, mission-critical network that enabled the country’s first ever successful inter-regional telesurgery across a distance of more than 1,400 kilometers.
